notes.sowing: Plant nursery plants or rooted pieces of runner in spring, or in early fall. Mint spreads fast by underground runners, so grow it in a container, or in a large bottomless pot sunk into the bed with its rim above the soil.
notes.care: Keep the soil evenly moist; mint grows in sun or part shade. A container above ground is the surest way to contain it, as runners escape sunk pots. Remove flower spikes to keep the leaves tender, and divide or repot every 3 to 4 years.
notes.harvest: Pick young shoot tips from late spring to fall; frequent cutting keeps fresh growth coming. Cut plants back to about {cm:5} after flowering for a new flush of leaves.
